govt.name: Kharidar
govt.need: SEE pass with at least GPA 2.0
govt.age: 18 to 35 years, up to 40 for women and candidates with disability
stages: Objective test of 100 marks, 45 to pass
Written paper on the service subject and general knowledge
Final selection with the written marks
prep: Read the latest syllabus from psc.gov.np
Finish general knowledge and the constitution first
Practise 100 question mock papers every week
Write short answers to build speed for the second paper
govt.note: Notices are published through the year. Applicant numbers are very high, so start early.

govt.name: Nayab Subba
govt.need: +2 pass or equivalent with at least GPA 2.0
govt.age: 18 to 35 years, up to 40 for women and candidates with disability
stages: Objective test of 100 marks, 45 to pass
Written papers on the service subject and general topics
prep: Match your service group to the syllabus
Revise +2 level maths and reasoning
Take timed mock papers
Review current affairs every month
govt.note: Open to +2 graduates from any stream for most administrative services.

govt.name: Section Officer
govt.need: Bachelor's degree from a recognised university
govt.age: 21 to 35 years, up to 40 for women and candidates with disability
stages: Administrative aptitude test of 100 marks, 45 to pass
Governance systems, contemporary issues and a service subject, each 100 marks
Computer skill test, group discussion and interview
prep: Read the syllabus and past questions
Build a base in governance and the constitution
Practise writing structured subjective answers
Train for group discussion and the interview
govt.note: Engineers, doctors, lawyers and auditors apply through their own service groups with a matching degree.

govt.name: Engineer (technical services)
govt.need: Bachelor in the matching engineering field and council registration
govt.age: 21 to 35 years, up to 40 for women and candidates with disability
prep: Revise final year core subjects
Study the technical syllabus for your group
Practise past technical papers
govt.note: Check the notice for your branch such as civil, electrical, computer or mechanical.

govt.name: Nepal Police
govt.need: SEE for constable, +2 or bachelor for higher posts, set by each notice
govt.age: Stricter limits than civil posts, set in each notice
stages: Height, chest, running and fitness standards
prep: Start running and strength training months ahead
Prepare general knowledge and the constitution
Check height and eyesight rules in the notice
govt.note: The Armed Police Force and Nepal Army run similar stages with their own notices.

govt.name: Nepali Army and Armed Police
govt.need: Varies by post, shown in each notice
govt.age: Strict limits, shown in each notice
govt.body: Nepali Army and Armed Police Force
prep: Build daily fitness
Revise general knowledge
Read each notice for exact rules
govt.note: Officer cadet and soldier routes have separate notices.

govt.name: Teacher licence and permanent post
govt.need: Education qualification for the level, set by the Teacher Service Commission
govt.age: Check the notice for the age rule
stages: Written test that gives the teaching licence
prep: Choose the level that matches your degree
Study the subject syllabus and teaching methods
Take mock tests for the licence exam
govt.note: Licence is the first step. Permanent posts follow separate vacancies.

govt.name: Bank officer and assistant
govt.need: Bachelor for officer, +2 for assistant, as each notice says
govt.age: Usually 21 to 35 years for officer posts
govt.body: Rastriya Banijya Bank, Nepal Bank and other public banks
stages: Aptitude, accounting, banking and general knowledge
prep: Revise accounting and banking basics
Practise aptitude papers
Follow bank notices and Nepal Rastra Bank updates
govt.note: Private banks recruit through their own tests. Public bank notices appear in national newspapers.
